c74object.name: syncSuite.nodes
c74object.digest: Multi-source spatializer UI: speakers and sources on a 2D field, VBAP / DBAP gains on request.
c74object.description: Speakers are nodes placed on a normalized 0..1 field (listener at the centre, front = up); sources are knobs that move around it. For every source the object computes one gain per speaker with VBAP (default) or DBAP, and outputs them only when asked with "get_gains", so moving sources (from the mouse or from automation) costs almost nothing. Sources can be mono or stereo (linked L/R pair) and can be mirrored. Speaker i is always the i-th value of the "speakers" list. Indices are 1-based. Problematic VBAP layouts are reported once in the Max Console together with what the object does about them. Gains are constant power (sum of squared gains = 1 per channel), as in VBAP and DBAP: a source on a speaker is 0 dB; distance_attenuation lowers sources inside the speaker ring towards the centre. Smoothing of the gains is left to the audio objects that apply them.

outlet.description: One list per source channel: <source> <channel> <g1> ... <gN>, one amplitude gain per speaker in speaker-list order, sum of squares = 1. Mono sources output channel 1, stereo sources channel 1 (L) and 2 (R). Nothing is output unless requested.
With get_gains, DBAP sources with dbap_hull 1 also report hull_distance <source> <channel> <d>. get_geometry reports each source centre as seen from each speaker.

Messages in the same format as the inlet, so they can be stored or sent back: source <i> <az> <dist>, source_spread, source_blur, stereo_width, speaker <i> <az> <dist>, speaker_coords... Mouse edits of positions are only reported with output_source_position 1. Inlet messages are never echoed, so this outlet can drive live.dial / pattr and be fed back in without a loop.

method.name: speaker_coords
method.digest: Define the speaker layout by azimuth
method.description: One speaker per value, in degrees (0 = front, clockwise), placed on a ring of radius 0.4 around the centre. The order of the list is the speaker index: speaker i is always the i-th value and gain i is always for it; the list is never re-ordered. Same message as syncSuite.virtualspeakers~, and what get_speakers outputs. "speaker_coords" with no values removes all speakers.

method.name: speaker
method.description: Azimuth in degrees (0 = front, clockwise) and optional distance from the centre (default 0.4, the ring). Positions beyond the field are pulled in along their ray, so the azimuth is kept. Distance matters for DBAP; VBAP only uses the azimuth.

method.name: speaker_azimuth
method.digest: Set a speaker's azimuth, keeping its distance

method.name: speaker_distance
method.digest: Set a speaker's distance, keeping its azimuth

method.name: speaker_weight
method.description: w_i in the DBAP equations (default 1). 0 silences the speaker for DBAP sources. Without an index it applies to all speakers.

method.name: num_sources
method.description: Existing sources keep their settings; mirror links to removed sources are dropped.

method.name: sources_mode
method.description: One flag per source, in order: 0 = mono (default), 1 = stereo. "sources_mode 0 1 0 0" makes source 2 stereo. Sources beyond the list keep their mode; extra flags are ignored with a message.

method.name: source
method.description: Azimuth in degrees (0 = front, clockwise), distance from the centre in normalized units. Positions beyond the field are pulled in along their ray, so the azimuth is kept. Only stores the position: gains are computed on the next get_gains.

method.name: source_azimuth
method.digest: Set a source's azimuth, keeping its distance

method.name: source_distance
method.digest: Set a source's distance, keeping its azimuth

method.name: stereo_width
method.description: L sits at azimuth - width/2 and R at + width/2, at the source's distance (0..180, default 60). L and R are always linked. Without an index it applies to all sources.

method.name: mirror_sources
method.description: "mirror_sources a b [lr|fb|point]" links b as a's mirror and moves it there; moving either one moves the other. lr (default) mirrors left/right (az -> -az, opposite rotation), fb front/back (az -> 180 - az), point through the centre (az + 180). Only positions are mirrored. "mirror_sources a" unlinks a, "mirror_sources" unlinks all.

method.name: algorithm
method.description: 0 = VBAP (default), 1 = DBAP. Without an index it applies to all sources.

method.name: source_spread
method.description: 0..1: the fraction of the full circle the source covers (0 = point source, plain VBAP; 0.25 = 90 degrees; 1 = 360 degrees, the whole circle). Spread 1 (100%) means all speakers receive the same level when the speakers are evenly spaced (ring, quad, octagon...); on irregular layouts such as 5.0, speakers covering wider gaps receive more. Pans virtual sources 1 degree apart across that width and renormalizes (MDAP), so the source reaches more speakers while keeping its loudness. Drawn as a halo around the source; cmd-drag a source up/down to change it. Without an index it applies to all sources.

method.name: vbap_center_blend
method.digest: Blend towards all speakers inside the ring
method.description: 1 (default): inside the speaker ring, gains blend at constant power towards all speakers equal, reaching it at the centre, so crossing the middle does not jump. 0: textbook VBAP (direction only).

method.name: source_blur
method.description: r_s = blur * sigma, where sigma is the spread of the speaker positions (as in Jamoma's j.dbap). More blur reaches more speakers. Drawn as a halo of radius r_s around the source; cmd-drag a source up/down to change it. Without an index it applies to all sources.

method.name: dbap_rolloff
method.digest: DBAP rolloff in dB per doubling of distance
method.description: Default 6 (inverse distance law). Must be > 0.

method.name: dbap_hull
method.digest: Project DBAP sources outside the speakers onto their hull
method.description: 1 (default): a source outside the convex hull of the speakers is projected onto it and its distance to the hull is reported as hull_distance.

method.name: distance_attenuation
method.digest: Level at the centre for all sources
method.description: 0 dB on the speaker ring (the speakers' average distance from the centre), fading linearly in dB to this value at the exact centre; sources on or outside the ring are not changed. "distance_attenuation -6": every source is -6 dB at the centre and -3 dB halfway. Applied after panning, to VBAP and DBAP, to both channels of stereo sources. Sources with their own source_distance_attenuation keep it. Default 0.

method.name: source_distance_attenuation
method.description: Overrides distance_attenuation for one source; later global changes do not affect it. Without a value the source follows the global setting again.

method.name: get_gains
method.description: Outputs all sources, or one source (all its channels), on the left outlet. Only sources that changed are recomputed.

method.name: get_source
method.description: source <i> <az> <dist> on the right outlet, for all sources or one.

method.name: get_speakers
method.description: speaker_coords <az1> <az2> ... on the right outlet: each speaker's direction from the centre, in speaker order. It is the input format of this object and of syncSuite.virtualspeakers~ / mc.syncSuite.virtualspeakers~.

method.name: get_geometry
method.description: On the middle outlet, per the geometry and format settings.

method.name: geometry
method.description: polar: <source> <speaker> <az> <dist>; cartesian: <source> <speaker> <dx> <dy>.

method.name: format
method.description: pair: one message per source/speaker pair; list: one row per source.

method.name: dump
method.description: All speaker and source settings on the right outlet, as messages that can be sent back in.

method.name: output_source_position
method.description: 1: source positions changed with the mouse are sent from the right outlet (source <i> <az> <dist>), including a mirrored partner. Default 0.

method.name: edit_speakers
method.description: With 1, drag a speaker to move it.

method.name: draw_distance
method.description: Line opacity follows the gain. Default 0.

method.name: draw_spread
method.digest: Draw the spread / blur halo around sources
method.description: Default 1.

method.name: draw_sources
method.description: Default 1.

method.name: draw_speakers
method.description: Default 1.

method.name: draw_intensity
method.digest: Write the selected source's level next to each speaker
method.description: With 1, each speaker shows the gain it receives from the selected source in dB and as amplitude (L and R lines for a stereo source). Default 1.

method.name: select_source
method.digest: Select the source shown on the speakers
method.description: Speakers light up (on a dB scale: near 0 dB a speaker turns bright orange, swells and glows; -24 dB and below it stays dark grey) (and draw_intensity writes levels) for the selected source only. Clicking a source also selects it. Default: source 1.

method.name: speaker_size
method.description: Width of the speaker squares in pixels (4..60, default 14). Display only.

method.name: source_size
method.description: Diameter of the source knobs in pixels (4..60, default 16). Display only; the spread/blur halo starts outside the knob.

method.name: bypass_ui
method.description: With 1 nothing is drawn and the mouse is inactive; every message still applies and get_gains still returns correct gains.
